pages.title: Account help
pages.preamble: General account information, terms, and support notices apply to all customers.
sections:
## Sign in
Enter your email address and password to sign in.

## Password reset
Select Forgot password on the sign-in screen to receive a reset link by email.

## Billing
Update your credit card from the billing settings page.

## Two-factor authentication
Use a recovery code if you lose your authentication device.

pages.title: Service operations guide
pages.preamble: Operational overview and general deployment notes for the service.
sections:
## Connection failure
Error E_CONN_042 means the database pool is exhausted. Increase the pool limit after checking for leaked connections.

## Timeout failure
Error E_CONN_043 means the upstream request timed out. Check network connectivity.

## Backups
Restore a backup by stopping writes and applying the latest verified snapshot.

## Pool configuration
Set FETCH_POOL_LIMIT to control the number of fetch workers.

pages.title: Product comparison
pages.preamble: Our product guide compares models and availability.
sections:
## Apex 100
The Apex 100 has a battery life of 8 hours and weighs 2 pounds.

## Apex 200
The Apex 200 has a battery life of 16 hours and weighs 3 pounds.

## Warranty
The standard warranty covers manufacturing defects for one year.

pages.title: Workplace policy
pages.preamble: This guide describes workplace benefits and procedures.
sections:
## Holidays
Employees receive ten paid holidays each calendar year.

## Parental leave
New parents may take twelve weeks of paid leave after a birth or adoption.

## Sick leave
Employees may use sick leave when they are unable to work due to illness.

## Returning to work
Contact your manager before returning from any extended absence.

pages.title: Release notes
sections:
## Version 1.0 migration
Migration requires exporting settings manually.

## Version 2.0 migration
Migration imports settings automatically using the migrate command.

## Version 3.0 migration
Migration requires the new upgrade assistant.

pages.title: Deployment example
sections:
## Shutdown
Stop the service before changing the configuration.
